title: Marriage and family therapist licensing program.
bodyText: There is established a marriage and family therapist licensing program within the department. The program shall be administered by the director.
bodyHtml: [§451J-2]  Marriage and family therapist licensing program.  There is established a marriage and family therapist licensing program within the department.  The program shall be administered by the director. [L 1998, c 159, pt of §2]
